name: Miyuki-san o Dounika Shitai!
original_name: みゆきさんをどうにかしたい!
source: This is a short visual novel in which Miyuki-san is captured in a karaoke room by men she barely knows and unable to put up much of a resistance, she is forced to sexually service them.
translation: 这是一部短篇视觉小说：美雪小姐在卡拉OK包厢里遭到几名素昧平生的男人拘禁，无力反抗的她被迫用身体为他们提供性奉仕。
